concernLibrary.label: Money feels tight
concernLibrary.question: Money is tight this month. What comes first?
concernLibrary.lead: Separate getting through this month from longer-term changes. Start with money already available and protect food, housing, and essential travel.
steps: List your balance, next confirmed income, and bills due before then.
Set aside essentials and pause one purchase that can wait.
Confirm any payment arrangements and their total costs directly with the provider.
followups: What facts do I need to check first?
What if things do not go as I hope?
followupAnswers: List your balance, next confirmed income, and bills due before then.
Confirm any payment arrangements and their total costs directly with the provider.
concernLibrary.lens: This is an editorial reflection, not a prediction from your birth chart.

concernLibrary.label: Exams and study

Schedule a break and a second attempt at one difficult topic.
followups: What facts do I need to check first?

concernLibrary.label: Business and clients

Make one offer clearer: who it helps, what it includes, and the price.
Test the change with a small group and record what happens.
followups: What facts do I need to check first?
What if things do not go as I hope?
followupAnswers: Review recent inquiries, actual orders, and unanswered questions.
Test the change with a small group and record what happens.

name: 对分相
มุมเล็ง
reading: 练习把自我表达与责任放在一起看：怎样既提出自己的想法，也给现实条件留出空间？
ฝึกมองการแสดงตัวตนร่วมกับความรับผิดชอบ จะเสนอความคิดของตนเองพร้อมคำนึงถึงเงื่อนไขจริงได้อย่างไร

name: 四分相
มุมฉาก
reading: 练习区分想法与行动的节奏：先确认对方听懂了什么，再决定下一步怎么做。
ฝึกแยกจังหวะความคิดกับการลงมือทำ ตรวจสอบก่อนว่าอีกฝ่ายเข้าใจอะไร แล้วค่อยกำหนดขั้นตอนถัดไป

name: 三分相
มุมตรีโกณ
reading: 练习把喜欢与想象分开：欣赏美好，同时用实际相处核对自己的期待。
ฝึกแยกความชอบกับจินตนาการ ชื่นชมสิ่งดี ๆ พร้อมตรวจสอบความคาดหวังจากการอยู่ร่วมกันจริง
